title: HW↔PO-001: Hardware Milestone & Cost Reporting + BOM Cost vs Product Budget
description: The Hardware Engineer provides unit-cost estimates, BOM (Bill of Materials) cost rollups, certification status, lead-time / supply-risk, hardware-revision availability dates, and manufacturing-readiness updates; the Product Owner/TPM provides roadmap visibility into upcoming hardware-dependent features, field durability / deployment-environment requirements, cost and schedule targets, certification scope, and volume forecasts. Grounded in HARDWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.7 and PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.2. A BOM rollup exceeding the PO-provided cost target is raised as a cost-exceedance ADR, never silently traded (Never-Silently-Deviate); budget tolerance bands per CLAUDE §6.5 are not yet instantiated, so the boolean within_budget is reported rather than a fabricated ± margin.

hardware_status_report.description: HW→PO: unit cost, BOM rollup, certification, lead-time / supply risk, hardware-revision availability, manufacturing readiness.

bom_vs_budget.description: BOM rollup vs the PO cost target; an over-budget rollup requires a cost-exceedance ADR (no fabricated tolerance band — CLAUDE §6.5 bands NOT YET AVAILABLE).

po_hardware_inputs.description: PO→HW: roadmap, field/deployment requirements, cost/schedule targets, certification scope, volume forecast.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine hardware milestone, cost, and lead-time reporting is agent-autonomous (bi-weekly / per hardware milestone). A BOM rollup over the PO cost target is not silently traded — it is raised as a cost-exceedance ADR (Tier-2 governance); a lead-time shift forces immediate PO notification.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER + CALENDAR (requirement intake; bi-weekly or per hardware milestone; cost/schedule reviews; release-gate manufacturing-readiness; immediate notification if lead times shift)
confirm_conditions: every cost figure (unit cost, BOM rollup, cost target) carries a value, a currency, and a per-unit unit
volume forecast and component lead times carry explicit units
bom_vs_budget states within_budget; an over-budget rollup carries a cost-exceedance ADR reference
a lead-time shift is flagged for immediate PO notification
reject_conditions: a cost, lead-time, or volume quantity emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a BOM rollup over the PO cost target presented as acceptable without a cost-exceedance ADR (Never-Silently-Deviate)
manufacturing_readiness = PRODUCTION_READY asserted while a mandatory certification is NOT_STARTED/FAILED (Honesty Over Polish §10.3)
counter_conditions: a fabricated ± tolerance band invoked to call an over-budget BOM 'within budget' — CLAUDE §6.5 bands are NOT YET AVAILABLE; request the instantiated band or raise the ADR
a single-source component on the critical path lacks a second-source plan — request supply-risk mitigation before manufacturing-readiness sign-off
